interpretation_review.specimen_joins: Printed concordance supplies three purposefully checked registrations. Aggregate API margins supply no registration to join those rows to a joint physical observation. The current report describes this gap.
interpretation_review.chronology: 2026 is the publication date shown in both acquired volumes. Depth margins alone supply no calendar date; the report requests dated intermediate or contact evidence for historical connection.
interpretation_review.numeral_meaning: The line counts describe published graphic classes. No independently measured numerical referent or unit was found in the inspected API schemas. Current prose treats counts and proposed value tests accordingly.
interpretation_review.terminology_recommendation: Define stroke block as consecutive stroke components in the normalized array. Form 39.13C has one such block containing two separately displayed groups of three strokes.
interpretation_review.4.19C_status: Terminal-label difference was reported to root; current REPORT and RETROSPECTIVE include it while frozen results retain their original fields.
